text:
tariq (CS): FYI escalated from account team — DataVault requested Net 60 and a PO-based workflow before we resume service. their card declined on renewal and procurement insists on PO first.
olivia (Billing): invoice INV-2024-0412 was auto-generated and attempted charge failed with code card_declined. customer sent PO#8453 and a signed SOW but asked for net60 payment terms.
emma (Finance): Net 60 is outside standard policy. default is Net 30 for new accounts. do we have credit references or DUNS for them?
jordan (Sales Ops): Sales says this is a strategic customer, likely >$50k ARR. They want net60 as a condition for moving to enterprise tier. provided PO and signed SOW — can we do an exception while we do checks?
mike (Legal): Any contract addendum? Net terms change needs approval and updated invoicing terms in the contract. also need VAT handling — are they EU? reverse-charge?
Data pasted by tariq (CS): "Customer billing profile: DataVault Inc., UK VAT: GB123456789, billing contact: procurement@datavault.com. PO attached in their email."
olivia (Billing): VAT looks present. for UK VAT we need to check reverse charge applicability. if reverse-charge applies, we need the customer's VAT reg number validated before invoicing.
emma (Finance): OK — immediate blockers: 1) credit check/trade refs 2) validated VAT number 3) signed amendment for Net 60 or written approval from FP&A. can we get trade refs?
jordan (Sales Ops): I can ask the AE to pull trade refs and the procurement lead to confirm billing cycle. AE says they can provide two trade refs within today.
tariq (CS): customer says they can't approve payment from their card until PO flows through on their side — they're on strict procurement windows. they need service resumed in the meantime for a live demo Friday.
olivia (Billing): we can issue a pro forma invoice on PO terms but we need legal/finance approval to accept Net 60. pro forma won't enable service — only contract amendment will.
mike (Legal): I can draft a one-page amendment that sets Net 60 and requires the PO# on invoices and an irrevocable purchase order acceptance clause. Need sign-off from Finance.
emma (Finance): If sales confirms trade refs and AE commitment to collect the PO, I can provisionally approve Net 60 for one invoice only (INV-2024-0412) pending credit check. We'll require pre-approved limit and auto-fail to prepaid if the account goes past term.
jordan (Sales Ops): Noted. I'll get trade refs and the procurement contact on a quick call. @tariq, can you share the procurement contact email and a copy of the PO?
tariq (CS): procurement@datavault.com — attaching PO snippet: "PO#8453 | Total £48,500 | billing to Redwood Inference Ltd." attaching screenshot of procure approval timestamp.
invoices-bot: Payment attempt failed for INV-2024-0412 — status: payment_failed, reason: card_declined. retry window: 24h.
olivia (Billing): Next steps I need from Sales/CS: 1) trade refs 2) DUNS or company reg # 3) confirmation of VAT reverse-charge applicability. Finance will run credit check once we have that.
mike (Legal): I'll prepare amendment language and include a clause that the Net 60 approval is contingent on completed credit check and a one-time grace for the current invoice. If anything beyond that, requires exec approval.
emma (Finance): Also flag: if they are UK-based and reclaiming VAT via reverse-charge, we must store the validated VAT transaction evidence for audits.
jordan (Sales Ops): AE confirmed will send trade refs and the procurement POC is available for a 30-min call in 2 hours. I'll coordinate.
tariq (CS): Customer asks if we can enable a temporary limited-service access (feature-flag) so the demo isn't blocked — low-risk. Is that doable without full billing cleared?
olivia (Billing): We typically require subscription active state to enable production keys. For demos we can grant a temporary demo key for staging only, but it must be isolated and not billed until terms resolved.
emma (Finance): That's acceptable if Legal signs the demo access waiver. Mike?
mike (Legal): I can write a short demo-access waiver: limited scope, no SLA, termination if billing not settled. will send in thread.
olivia (Billing): Once trade refs come back and VAT validated, I'll mark INV-2024-0412 as "approved for Net 60 provisional" and queue the amendment for signature.
jordan (Sales Ops): I'll post updates here after the call. aiming to have trade refs and signed amendment by EOD.
tariq (CS): thanks team — keeping customer updated. will ping if procurement confirms PO acceptance on their side.
emma (Finance): Quick checklist for closure: [trade refs], [VAT validated], [amendment signed], [demo waiver if staging requested].
mike (Legal): Draft sent — please review. I'll wait for finance approval text before finalizing.
olivia (Billing): marking thread with invoice number and PO for records. INV-2024-0412 / PO#8453.
jordan (Sales Ops): call ended — trade refs received. pushing for signatures now.
tariq (CS): procurement confirmed PO visibility in their system — they expect payment on Net 60 after invoice date. will update if any change.
emma (Finance): provisional approval granted for this single invoice with Net 60, conditioned on completed credit check results. I'll update system and notify billing.
olivia (Billing): done — updated invoice notes and set payment terms Net 60 provisional. will not retry card charge while on PO workflow.
invoices-bot: Invoice INV-2024-0412 status updated to "net_terms_pending_approval".
tariq (CS): customer very relieved, demo on Friday still on. closing escalation unless something else pops up. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
